[{"node":"menu_content105","element":"menu_content","data":{"label":"Docs Printers","key":"docs_printers_menu_content","id":"docs_printers_menu_content","name":"docs_printers_menu_content"},"elements":[{"node":"markdown101","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Printers","key":"md_printers","id":"printers","name":"md_printers","value":"# Printers

Ren POS prints straight to thermal printers on your network: kitchen tickets at each production center, and bills, receipts and the cash drawer at the register."}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Add a printer","key":"md_add_a_printer","id":"add-a-printer","name":"md_add_a_printer","value":"# Add a printer

**Restaurant workspace → Printers → New**:

- **Printer Name**: Kitchen, Bar, Front register…
- **Connection**: *Network (ESC/POS)*: Epson TM, Star in ESC/POS mode and most 80 mm printers.
- **IP Address / Host** and **Port** (usually 9100). The ERPNext server must be able to reach the printer: same network, or a VPN when the server is in the cloud.
- **Paper Width** (80 or 58 mm), **Characters per Line** (empty: 48 for 80 mm, 32 for 58 mm), **Cut Paper**, **Copies**.
- **Beep on Kitchen Tickets**: the printer beeps when a ticket arrives (kitchens are loud).

Save and use **Print test page** at the top of the form to check it."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Where each thing prints","key":"md_where_each_thing_prints","id":"where-each-thing-prints","name":"md_where_each_thing_prints","value":"# Where each thing prints

| What | Printer | Set in |
|---|---|---|
| Kitchen tickets, voids of sent items | the production center's printer | the station's **Kitchen Ticket Printer** |
| Bill (check before paying) | the receipt printer | POS Profile → Restaurant tab → **Receipt Printer** |
| Receipt after paying, cash drawer | the receipt printer | POS Profile → Restaurant tab |

On the POS Profile you also choose whether to **Print Kitchen Tickets on Send**, **Print Receipt After Payment** and **Open Cash Drawer on Cash Payments**. The drawer is opened through the receipt printer (the usual RJ11 cable).

The **Bill** and receipt buttons of the POS need a receipt printer. Without printers you can still print any invoice from the Desk with ERPNext's print view."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"When printing fails","key":"md_when_printing_fails","id":"when-printing-fails","name":"md_when_printing_fails","value":"# When printing fails

If a printer is off, out of paper or unreachable, the person who printed gets a message with **Try again**. Every job is kept in **Print Jobs** with its status and error, so you can see what didn't print. See [Troubleshooting](/Docs/Troubleshooting)."}}]}]
